summary: Completed iteration 3 regression testing: all 13 public backend checks passed, while desktop/mobile dashboard flows and native API controls were exercised. One Backup Now messaging mismatch remains for demo data.

integration_issues.issue: The button calls the demo router ID and receives 404 'Router not found in managed inventory'; the configuration-gated UX should explicitly explain that backup execution is unavailable until backup settings and a managed router are configured.

action_items: Make Backup Now detect demo/unmanaged router state or add a configuration gate before POST, and show an explicit configuration-required message rather than a missing-inventory error.
critical_code_review_comments: Monitoring overview and RouterOS reads/writes are MOCKED/demo or configuration-gated; binary/text backup transfer, encryption, SMTP attachments, and scheduler execution are not live.
Authentication and tenant/RBAC enforcement remain intentionally deferred; management endpoints must stay behind a trusted network until implemented.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing demo overview fleet and created no managed router records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health/overview, allow-lists, item ID validation, secret-free history, drawer tabs, native API label, search, mobile navigation, and direct API error toasts passed. Retest Backup Now messaging after the demo/configuration gate is adjusted. Live RouterOS, backups, SMTP, scheduler, authentication, and RBAC remain untested and MOCKED/configuration-gated.
test_credentials: Not applicable; no auth flow was tested and no credentials were supplied.
rca of the issue: The frontend always posts /api/routers/{selected-or-first-demo-id}/backup-now. The backend first calls router_doc(), so demo IDs that are not persisted return 404 before reaching its configuration-required response. Gate the action for demo data or return a consistent configuration-required status/message for this safe preview state.
